specialEventConditions.title: New Years 2025-26
specialEventConditions.description: CHRISTMAS AND NEW YEAR'S 2025/2026 -- Due to the holidays, there will be no check-in/out on December 24/25/26th and the 31st December and 1st January. Any bookings that contain a check in or check out on these days will be subject to immediate cancellation.

freeCancellation.label: Free Cancellation rates
freeCancellation.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 30th Dec 2025 (AEST) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 30th Dec 2025 (AEST) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.
